newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-PANEL GRANTS VILFIMA ASSET MANAGEMENT PERMIT.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-PANEL GRANTS VILFIMA ASSET MANAGEMENT PERMIT.

text.p: Lithuania's securities commission on Friday granted a license for Vilfima to start an asset management company, the commission said.
"The commission approved its request for a license to act as an asset management and consulting company," Dalius Simenas, a public relations officer at the commission, told Reuters.
Vilfima is one of the top three brokerages in Lithuania.
Vilfima said it plans to move its individual, T-bill and equities portfolios over to Vilfima Asset Management.
The new company is also expected to manage any investment funds that Vilfima decides to create in the future.
Vilfima broker Grazhina Bachiuliene is expected to be Asset Management's general manager.
